examples.en: Either side can terminate the contract.
The road terminates at the beach.
We will terminate the service next month.
The app terminates when the battery is low.
examples.ar: التطبيق يتوقف عندما تكون البطارية منخفضة.

examples.en: Managers can terminate staff for theft.
